description: Pick context blocks that fit a token budget, keeping mandatory blocks and their dependencies — Chooses which context items an agent should put into a prompt without exceeding a token budget: every mandatory item and everything it depends on is always included, then optional items by descending priority (each with the dependencies it pulls in) while they fit. Token counts come from the caller or from o200k_base / cl100k_base; any other tokenizer name returns unsupported (there is no Claude t

budget.description: Maximum total tokens (including perItemOverhead per included item).

items.description: Up to 500 items, 300000 characters of text in total.

dependsOn.description: Ids that must be included whenever this item is.

mandatory.description: Always included, with its dependencies; if they cannot fit the result is fail.

priority.description: Higher is packed first among optional items. Default 0.

text.description: Content to count when tokens is not given.

tokens.description: Caller-supplied token count; always accepted and used in preference to counting text.

perItemOverhead.description: Tokens added per included item for separators or wrappers. Default 0.

tokenizer.description: o200k_base or cl100k_base. Any other name (including Claude models) returns status unsupported for items that need counting; caller token counts are always accepted.

name: context-pack
